trajectory_summary: The call opens cold with a cost objection and never recovers — each rep attempt to reframe surfaces a new, deeper barrier (grief, distrust from being exploited, age/mortality, home clutter) until the customer stacks enough reasons to end the call cleanly. Energy leaked steadily rather than building, and the rep's disengagement at 04:56 reads as reactive exhaustion rather than a strategic hold for a later touch.
